rationale: macos-26 runners observed 2.05-2.16 across four PR #78 rounds (2026-07-24) with hot loops already unchecked; the C reference uses a 4-byte-int stack array with byte-memset init while Iron fills 8-byte Ints on the heap, so the gap is element width and allocation, not bounds checks. 2.7x = 2.16 observed + 25% headroom, same formula as the previous 2.1x (Linux 1.70 + 25%, 2026-04-11).
